comparison.objective: Join two 2×2 blocks across four studs and verify retention by lifting; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Stud alignment, press-fit insertion, force application, and lift verification versus recessed key engagement, controlled collar rotation, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: All four studs must engage and retain the lower block during lift before release; candidate requires measured dynamic response and post-lock drift control. Fit-force and alignment tolerances are unstated.
comparison.reason: Press-fit assembly and retention lifting are different from tunable damping and fastener locking.
